name: Webhook Validator API
shortDescription: Deterministic webhook config + payload best-practice checklist — HTTPS, signature, replay, idempotency, timeouts, JSON
description: Agent-native webhook best-practice validation computed by real rule-based checks (not a language model). /validate accepts any subset of webhook configuration fields — endpoint url, signature verification, timestamp/replay protection, idempotency, content-type, handler timeout, retry budget, max payload size — plus an optional sample raw body, and returns a typed checks[] (each with id, severity from critical to info, pass/fail/warn status, message, and a concrete recommendation), pass/fail/warning counts, and a 0–100 validation_score with a production-readiness verdict (production_ready, needs_attention, not_production_ready). The one-call /lookup adds a reasoning object and a prioritized, severity-ordered fix list. Results are deterministic so confidence is always 1.0; nothing is stored.
